title: New AnimatedMock don't call animation end callback

labels.name: Stale
labels.description: There has been a lack of activity on this issue and it may be closed soon.

body:
This commit (https://github.com/facebook/react-native/commit/45686c86e2b50c98436d511dd63f0e987f565008#diff-35653b5f6360716ec796e5ffdd483841) introduce a mock mode for React Native Animated module. This mode is activated when you build your ios application with the Debug target.

However, we use the `onModalShow` and `onModalHide` (from react-native-modal) in order to navigate through our application. Those functions are called when the animation's start callback is called. The mock mode doesn't execute the callback and broke the normal behaviour.

I tried some fixes but I can't make it work properly.
Thanks for your help.

--
